name: PMO Project Financial Status
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Project:Link/PMO Project:220",
    project_title AS "Project:Data:220",
    project_code AS "Project Code:Data:140",
    approved_budget AS "Approved Budget:Currency:150",
    actual_cost AS "Actual Cost:Currency:150",
    (COALESCE(approved_budget, 0) - COALESCE(actual_cost, 0))
        AS "Variance:Currency:150",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Project`
ORDER BY
    (COALESCE(approved_budget, 0) - COALESCE(actual_cost, 0))
